subject: Having difficulty with adding a variable to a url link in uiOutput

messages.author: 0366928fd06f3534
messages.subject: Having difficulty with adding a variable to a url link in uiOutput
parts:
I am trying to create a link to twitter pages based on a selectInput selection

So in ui.R have

selectInput("name","Tweeter",personChoice, selected="Jennifer Bryan"),
uiOutput('twitterLink')


and in server.R

output$twitterLink <- renderUI({
  
  twitterUrl <-df[df$name==input$name,]$screenName 
print(twitterUrl #JennyBryan

# a("Twitter", class="web", href="https://twitter.com/JennyBryan") Hard code works

paste0('a(\"Twitter\", class=\"web\", href=\"https://twitter.com/',twitterUrl,'\")')

})

results in the text 
 
a("Twitter", class="web", href="https://twitter.com/JennyBryan") in the browser

TIA

messages.subject: Re: Having difficulty with adding a variable to a url link in uiOutput
parts:
Needed to be of form
a("Twitter", class = "web", href = paste0('https://twitter.com/', twitterUrl))
